entries.en: Her hands were aquiver as she unfolded the long-awaited letter.
entries.zh: 她展开那封盼望已久的信时，双手颤抖着。

entries.en: The Arab-American student proudly showed me her new United States passport.
entries.zh: 那位美籍阿拉伯学生自豪地给我看了她新办的美国护照。

entries.en: The researcher filmed an arachnophagous insect approaching a small spider.
entries.zh: 研究人员拍下了一只食蜘蛛昆虫接近一只小蜘蛛的情景。

entries.en: The drawing uses araeosystyle to create pairs of columns along the facade.
entries.zh: 图纸在正立面采用对柱式，把柱子两两成对排列。

entries.en: She copied the Aramaean inscription carefully, leaving spaces for the damaged letters.
entries.zh: 她仔细临摹那段阿拉姆语铭文，为损坏的字母留出空白。

entries.en: An Aramean manuscript lay open beneath the library's reading lamp.
entries.zh: 图书馆阅览灯下摊着一份阿拉姆语手稿。

entries.en: The illustrator gave the alien an araneiform body with slender jointed legs.
entries.zh: 插画师给那个外星生物画了一个似蜘蛛的身体，配上细长且有节的腿。

entries.en: An araneose pattern spread across the cracked glaze of the old bowl.
entries.zh: 旧碗开裂的釉面上布满了蜘蛛网状的纹路。

entries.en: The park hired a consultant with extensive arboricultural experience.
entries.zh: 公园聘请了一位树木栽培经验丰富的顾问。

entries.en: An arc-like crack ran from the handle to the base of the mug.
entries.zh: 一条弧状裂纹从杯柄延伸到了杯底。

entries.en: The designer replaced the straight support with an arcate bracket.
entries.zh: 设计师把直支撑件换成了弓形支架。

entries.en: The archconservative opposed even the smallest change to the club's rules.
entries.zh: 那个极端保守的人连对俱乐部规则做最细微的改动都反对。

entries.en: The embryology diagram highlights the archenteric cavity in a contrasting colour.
entries.zh: 胚胎学示意图用对比色标出了原肠腔。

entries.en: The expedition's catalogue separates archibenthic specimens from the shallow-water collection.
entries.zh: 探险队的目录把亚深海标本与浅水采集品分开列出。

entries.en: The lecturer read an Archilochian stanza before discussing its changing rhythm.
entries.zh: 讲师先朗读了一节阿尔基洛科斯式诗节，再讨论其节奏变化。

entries.en: Her architective drawings filled two large portfolios in the studio.
entries.zh: 她那些关于建筑的图纸装满了工作室里的两个大画夹。

entries.en: The philosopher questioned the architectonical structure of her own earlier theory.
entries.zh: 这位哲学家质疑了自己早期理论那种成体系的结构。

entries.en: The librarian ordered archival-quality folders for the fragile letters.
entries.zh: 图书管理员为易损的信件订购了档案级文件夹。

entries.en: The historian examined an archontic decree without assigning it an exact date.
entries.zh: 历史学家考察了一道古雅典执政官的法令，但没有为它确定确切年代。

entries.en: The illustrator drew an archy doorway at the end of the passage.
entries.zh: 插画师在通道尽头画了一个拱形门洞。

entries.en: The botanist packed the arctic-alpine plant specimens in a separate insulated case.
entries.zh: 植物学家把高寒植物标本装进了另一个保温箱。

entries.en: Her field notebook records arcticalpine vegetation beside sketches of exposed rocks.
entries.zh: 她的野外笔记在裸露岩石的素描旁记录了高寒植被。

entries.en: An arctoid creature lumbered through the snow in the children's animation.
entries.zh: 儿童动画里，一只熊状生物步履笨重地走过雪地。

entries.en: My areligious neighbour enjoys the cathedral mainly for its architecture.
entries.zh: 我那位对宗教不感兴趣的邻居喜欢那座大教堂，主要是因为它的建筑。

entries.en: The gardener mixed compost into the arenarious soil behind the shed.
entries.zh: 园丁把堆肥混进了棚屋后面的沙质土壤中。

entries.en: We followed an arenose track until it disappeared beneath the dunes.
entries.zh: 我们沿着一条多沙的小路前行，直到小路消失在沙丘下面。

entries.en: The drill brought up a layer of arenous material from beneath the clay.
entries.zh: 钻头从黏土下面带上来一层砂质材料。

entries.en: A narrow strip of arenulous ground separated the garden from the stream.
entries.zh: 一条狭窄的多沙地带把花园和溪流隔开。

entries.en: The team converted the satellite's coordinates to an areocentric reference frame.
entries.zh: 团队把这颗卫星的坐标转换到了以火星为中心的参考系中。

entries.en: She compared the areographic maps before choosing a name for her fictional valley.
entries.zh: 她比较了那些火星地图，再给自己虚构的山谷取名。

entries.en: The model demonstrates areostyle with unusually wide gaps between its columns.
entries.zh: 这个模型展示了疏柱式，其柱子之间留有格外宽的空隙。

entries.en: The restoration team found traces of areosystyle beneath the later additions.
entries.zh: 修复团队在后期增建部分下面发现了对柱式布局的痕迹。

entries.en: An argental sheen appeared where the craftsman had polished the dark surface.
entries.zh: 工匠打磨过的深色表面泛起了似银的光泽。

entries.en: She embroidered an argentate border around the blue velvet panel.
entries.zh: 她在蓝色天鹅绒面料四周绣了一圈银色边饰。

entries.en: An argenteous mist hung above the lake before sunrise.
entries.zh: 日出前，湖面上笼罩着银灰色薄雾。

entries.en: The survey marked an argilliferous deposit near the old quarry.
entries.zh: 调查标出了旧采石场附近一处产黏土的矿床。

entries.en: The core sample contains an argillo-arenaceous layer beneath the darker sediment.
entries.zh: 岩芯样品中，较暗沉积物下方有一层泥砂质层。

entries.en: The geologist labelled the pale argillo-calcareous sample before packing it away.
entries.zh: 地质学家在收起那块浅色泥灰质样品前给它贴上了标签。

entries.en: The seminar compares argonautic adventures with other voyages in Greek mythology.
entries.zh: 研讨课把 Argo 号远征中的冒险与希腊神话中的其他航海故事作了比较。

entries.en: His argumental manner turned a simple question into an exhausting discussion.
entries.zh: 他那好争辩的态度把一个简单问题变成了令人疲惫的讨论。

entries.meaningZh: 好辩的〔argumentative 的较少用异体〕
entries.en: The usually quiet apprentice became argumentive whenever someone criticised his tools.
entries.zh: 平时安静的学徒一有人批评他的工具就变得好辩。

entries.en: An argute observer noticed the missing seal before the parcel was opened.
entries.zh: 一位机灵的观察者在包裹被打开前就注意到封条不见了。

entries.en: His arhythmic tapping made it difficult for the dancers to follow the beat.
entries.zh: 他那毫无节奏的敲击使舞者很难跟上拍子。

entries.en: The steep steps posed an added difficulty for visitors carrying heavy bags.
entries.zh: 陡峭的台阶给带着沉重行李的游客增添了一重困难。

entries.en: She gave the young violinist an admiring glance after the difficult solo.
entries.zh: 那段高难度独奏结束后，她钦佩地看了年轻小提琴手一眼。

entries.en: The scholarship aims to help students from less advantaged backgrounds.
entries.zh: 这项奖学金旨在帮助那些背景条件不那么优越的学生。

entries.en: He looked affronted when the waiter asked him to lower his voice.
entries.zh: 服务员请他小声一点时，他露出一副受到冒犯的神情。

entries.en: Despite his dramatic complaints, the old man was alive and kicking at breakfast.
entries.zh: 尽管那位老人抱怨得夸张，吃早餐时他还是活蹦乱跳的。

entries.en: Put down the map and tell me what happened; I'm all ears.
entries.zh: 把地图放下，告诉我发生了什么事；我正全神贯注地听着。

entries.en: The receptionist was all smiles when the lost suitcase finally arrived.
entries.zh: 丢失的行李箱终于送到时，前台接待员满面笑容。

entries.en: The bread tasted all the better after our long walk through the rain.
entries.zh: 在雨中走了长长一段路后，那面包吃起来更美味了。

entries.en: A detailed plan is all well and good, but we still need volunteers.
entries.zh: 有一份详细计划固然很好，但我们仍然需要志愿者。

entries.en: She chose an antiqued brass handle for the newly built cabinet.
entries.zh: 她给新做的柜子选了一个仿古黄铜把手。

entries.en: With the school concert around the corner, rehearsals filled every spare afternoon.
entries.zh: 学校音乐会即将来临，排练占满了每个空闲的下午。

entries.en: An arousing speech lifted the team's spirits before the final match.
entries.zh: 一场振奋人心的演说在决赛前鼓舞了全队的士气。

entries.meaningZh: 装艺术家派头的〔贬义；非正式〕
entries.en: The artsy-fartsy critic sneered at every painting that ordinary visitors enjoyed.
entries.zh: 那个装艺术家派头的评论家对普通参观者喜欢的每幅画都嗤之以鼻。

entries.meaningZh: 附庸风雅的〔英式；贬义；非正式〕
entries.en: She found the club's arty-farty discussions more exhausting than inspiring.
entries.zh: 她觉得俱乐部那些附庸风雅的讨论与其说是启发人，不如说是让人疲惫。

entries.en: The goalkeeper remained as cool as a cucumber during the penalty shootout.
entries.zh: 点球大战中，守门员始终极为冷静。

entries.en: The children were as good as gold throughout the long train journey.
entries.zh: 孩子们在漫长的火车旅途中一直乖得很。

entries.en: The landlord was as hard as nails when we asked for a little more time.
entries.zh: 我们请求再宽限一点时间时，房东显得冷酷无情。

entries.en: The youngest pupil is as keen as mustard on the new astronomy club.
entries.zh: 最小的学生对新成立的天文社团十分着迷。

entries.en: After a quiet weekend at home, I felt as right as rain again.
entries.zh: 在家安静地过了一个周末后，我又觉得身体完全好了。

entries.en: The surveyor says the old roof is as sound as a bell.
entries.zh: 测量员说，旧屋顶的结构十分完好。

entries.en: An ashen-faced passenger stepped off the bus after the frightening descent.
entries.zh: 可怕的下坡路走完后，一位脸色苍白的乘客下了公交车。

entries.en: The menu lists each file beside its associated application.
entries.zh: 菜单把每个文件列在与之关联的应用程序旁边。

entries.en: By noon, the argument was at an end and everyone wanted lunch.
entries.zh: 到中午时，争论结束了，大家都想吃午饭。

entries.en: An attention-grabbing poster covered the empty window of the abandoned shop.
entries.zh: 一张引人注目的海报盖住了那间废弃商店空空的橱窗。

entries.en: The textbook places auto-immune disorders in a chapter separate from allergies.
entries.zh: 教科书把自身免疫疾病放在了与过敏症分开的章节中。

entries.en: Clearing the fallen trees proved back-breaking work for the small volunteer crew.
entries.zh: 清理倒下的树木让这支人数不多的志愿队筋疲力尽。

entries.en: She left the committee after months of back-stabbing gossip and petty quarrels.
entries.zh: 在经历了数月暗箭伤人的闲言碎语和琐碎争吵后，她退出了委员会。

entries.en: The mayor called the proposal backward-looking and demanded a more ambitious alternative.
entries.zh: 市长称这项提议保守，并要求拿出更有雄心的替代方案。

entries.en: We were badly off that winter and shared a single heated room.
entries.zh: 那年冬天我们很穷，共用一间有暖气的房间。

entries.en: The suitcase was banged up, but the violin inside remained undamaged.
entries.zh: 行李箱磕碰坏了，里面的小提琴却完好无损。

entries.en: The cyclists leaned into the banked curve at the end of the track.
entries.zh: 骑手们倾斜身体，驶入赛道尽头带坡度的弯道。

entries.en: He offered a bare-faced lie about the missing money, despite the video evidence.
entries.zh: 尽管有录像证据，他还是对失踪的钱款撒了个厚颜无耻的谎。

entries.en: I found the spare curtains in the department store's bargain basement.
entries.zh: 我在百货商店的廉价商品部找到了备用窗帘。

entries.en: My friends thought I was barking mad to camp outside in that storm.
entries.zh: 朋友们觉得我居然在那场暴风雨中露营，简直是疯了。

entries.en: After the steep climb, his face was bathed in sweat.
entries.zh: 爬完那段陡坡后，他脸上汗水淋漓。

entries.en: A bejewelled hairpin glittered beneath the lights as the dancer turned.
entries.zh: 舞者转身时，一枚饰以珠宝的发簪在灯光下闪闪发亮。

entries.en: The charity introduced belt-tightening measures without cancelling its free meals.
entries.zh: 这家慈善机构采取了节省开支的措施，但没有取消免费餐食。

entries.en: The bevelled edge of the mirror caught a thin line of light.
entries.zh: 镜子的斜面边缘映出了一道细细的光。

entries.en: The rain-soaked manuscript looked beyond redemption until the conservator examined it.
entries.zh: 那份被雨淋透的手稿看似已无可挽回，直到修复师来检查。

entries.en: Winning one local prize made him so big-headed that his friends avoided him.
entries.zh: 赢得一个地方奖项就让他自大得连朋友们都躲着他。

entries.en: Our big-hearted neighbour welcomed the stranded travellers into her home.
entries.zh: 我们那位宽宏大量的邻居把受困旅客迎进了家中。

entries.en: The hospital replaced the curtains in its birthing room.
entries.zh: 医院更换了产房里的窗帘。

entries.en: She cut the sandwiches into bite-sized pieces before the children arrived.
entries.zh: 孩子们到来之前，她把三明治切成了适合一口吃下的小块。

entries.en: My knee was black and blue after I slipped on the stairs.
entries.zh: 我在楼梯上滑了一跤后，膝盖一片青肿。

entries.en: After the huge meal, I felt bloated and left the dessert untouched.
entries.zh: 吃完那顿大餐后，我觉得腹胀，没动甜点。

entries.en: A blood-curdling scream interrupted the quiet scene in the radio drama.
entries.zh: 广播剧中，一声令人毛骨悚然的尖叫打破了安静的场景。

entries.en: Her bobbed hair barely reached the collar of her coat.
entries.zh: 她剪短的头发刚到外套领口。

entries.en: The hotel supplied a bog-standard kettle rather than the espresso machine advertised.
entries.zh: 酒店提供的是一个普通水壶，而不是广告中的意式咖啡机。

entries.en: The project remained bogged down in paperwork while the building stood empty.
entries.zh: 大楼一直空着，项目却因文书工作而停滞不前。

entries.en: The soldier remained bolt upright even when the parade was delayed.
entries.zh: 即使阅兵推迟了，那名士兵仍然站得笔直。

entries.en: The shelter offered blankets to bombed-out families arriving after dark.
entries.zh: 收容所给天黑后抵达的、因轰炸而无家可归的家庭提供了毯子。

entries.en: The inspector counted the bonded goods before checking the warehouse records.
entries.zh: 检查员先清点了存入保税仓库的货物，再核查仓库记录。

entries.en: Every guest room was booked up for the festival weekend.
entries.zh: 节日周末的每一间客房都已预订一空。

entries.en: He arrived home boozed and apologised for leaving his keys in the taxi.
entries.zh: 他醉醺醺地回到家，为把钥匙落在出租车里而道歉。

entries.en: She set bottled lemonade beside the sandwiches on the picnic blanket.
entries.zh: 她把瓶装柠檬水放在野餐毯上的三明治旁边。

entries.en: She served bought biscuits alongside the bread she had baked herself.
entries.zh: 她把买来的饼干和自己烤的面包一起端了上来。

entries.en: The charity arranged transport for brain-damaged patients attending the art workshop.
entries.zh: 慈善机构为参加美术工作坊的脑部受损患者安排了交通。

entries.en: The bristling manager refused to discuss the complaint in front of customers.
entries.zh: 经理怒气冲冲，拒绝在顾客面前讨论那项投诉。

entries.en: Her broad-brush account left out the disagreements that delayed the project.
entries.zh: 她那粗线条的叙述略去了那些拖延项目的分歧。

entries.en: We waited for the delayed bus in the broiling afternoon sun.
entries.zh: 我们在下午酷热的阳光下等待晚点的公交车。

entries.en: The broken-hearted musician put the unfinished song away for several years.
entries.zh: 那位心碎的音乐家把未完成的歌搁置了好几年。

entries.en: He discovered that the towel was missing while standing buck naked beside the shower.
entries.zh: 他一丝不挂地站在淋浴间旁边时，才发现毛巾不见了。

entries.en: He left his buckled shoes beside the bedroom door.
entries.zh: 他把那双有搭扣的鞋留在了卧室门边。

entries.en: The children stood bug-eyed as the magician pulled flowers from the empty hat.
entries.zh: 魔术师从空帽子里拿出花来时，孩子们都瞪大了眼睛站着看。

entries.en: The costume designer hung the character's bullet-proof vest beside the police uniform.
entries.zh: 服装设计师把角色的防弹背心挂在警服旁边。

entries.en: A local bully-boy threatened anyone who questioned his brother's business dealings.
entries.zh: 一个当地恶棍威胁所有质疑他兄弟生意往来的人。

entries.en: The little cafe was bursting with customers after the concert.
entries.zh: 音乐会结束后，小咖啡馆里挤满了顾客。

entries.en: My cack-handed attempt at wrapping the gift left tape all over the table.
entries.zh: 我笨手笨脚地包装礼物，结果胶带粘得桌子上到处都是。

entries.en: The caged bird fell silent whenever a stranger approached the window.
entries.zh: 每当陌生人走近窗户时，那只关在笼子里的鸟就不叫了。

entries.en: His boots were caked with mud from the flooded field.
entries.zh: 他的靴子上厚厚地沾满了从积水田地里带来的泥。

entries.en: She wore a calf-length skirt with the boots she had repaired.
entries.zh: 她穿了一条长及腿肚子的裙子，配上自己修过的靴子。

entries.en: The called number appeared on the screen above the keypad.
entries.zh: 被呼叫的号码出现在键盘上方的屏幕上。

entries.en: The camera-shy chef slipped into the kitchen before the photographers arrived.
entries.zh: 那位不喜欢被拍照的厨师赶在摄影师到来之前溜进了厨房。

entries.en: The family remained camped beside the river throughout the repairs.
entries.zh: 修缮期间，那一家人一直在河边露宿。

entries.en: A cantilevered balcony projected above the narrow courtyard.
entries.zh: 一个带悬臂的阳台伸出在狭窄庭院的上方。

entries.en: The report compares capital-intensive manufacturing with businesses that need little equipment.
entries.zh: 报告把资金密集型制造业与设备需求很少的企业作了比较。

entries.en: The organiser promised the festival would be carbon neutral but supplied no calculations.
entries.zh: 组织者承诺节庆活动将实现碳中和，却没有提供计算数据。

entries.en: As a card-carrying member, she received the club's magazine every month.
entries.zh: 作为持会员证的会员，她每月都会收到俱乐部的杂志。

entries.en: His carping remarks about the curtains spoiled an otherwise pleasant dinner.
entries.zh: 他对窗帘吹毛求疵的评论破坏了一顿原本愉快的晚餐。

entries.en: The password is case-sensitive, so check the first letter carefully.
entries.zh: 密码区分大小写，因此请仔细检查第一个字母。

entries.en: The cash-starved theatre postponed its new production rather than dismiss the actors.
entries.zh: 资金短缺的剧院推迟了新剧制作，没有解雇演员们。

entries.en: Cash-strapped students shared the cost of a single second-hand textbook.
entries.zh: 经济困难的学生们分摊费用，合用一本二手教科书。

entries.en: Their midnight caterwauling about the cancelled party kept the whole house awake.
entries.zh: 他们半夜为派对取消而发出的哀诉声让整栋房子里的人都睡不着。

entries.en: The challenged assumption underlies several later arguments in the book.
entries.zh: 那个受到挑战的假设是书中后面几个论证的基础。

entries.en: She ordered char-grilled fish with a small bowl of rice.
entries.zh: 她点了烧烤得微焦的鱼，配一小碗米饭。

entries.en: The tutor's chastening criticism made me check the evidence more carefully.
entries.zh: 辅导老师那番促人改正的批评让我更仔细地核查证据。

entries.en: The childproof latch was difficult even for me to open.
entries.zh: 那个防止孩子乱开的锁扣连我打开都觉得费劲。

entries.en: The festival provided a chill-out room away from the crowded main stage.
entries.zh: 节庆活动设置了一间避开拥挤主舞台、让人放松的休息室。

entries.en: The chipped cup stayed on my desk long after its matching saucer broke.
entries.zh: 配套茶碟碎了很久之后，那个有缺口的杯子仍留在我桌上。

entries.en: The portrait emphasised his chiselled features with sharp contrasts of light and shade.
entries.zh: 肖像画用鲜明的明暗对比突出了他轮廓清晰的五官。

entries.en: She disliked the village's chocolate-box image on every tourist brochure.
entries.zh: 她不喜欢每本旅游手册里那个村庄好看却俗气的形象。

entries.en: Their clapped-out van needed another repair before it could carry the band's equipment.
entries.zh: 他们那辆破破烂烂的货车还得再修一次，才能拉乐队的设备。

entries.en: The path is clear of fallen branches now, although the gate remains locked.
entries.zh: 小路上现在没有倒下的树枝了，不过大门仍然锁着。

entries.en: Her clear-headed response helped us choose a route before the storm arrived.
entries.zh: 她头脑清楚的回应帮助我们赶在暴风雨到来前选定了路线。

entries.en: Each clickable image opens a larger version in a separate window.
entries.zh: 每张可点击的图片都会在单独的窗口中打开较大版本。

entries.en: A clinging layer of wet clay covered the spade after the digging.
entries.zh: 挖掘结束后，铁锹上覆盖着一层黏糊糊的湿黏土。

entries.meaningZh: 小圈子气氛浓厚的〔非正式〕
entries.en: The club felt cliquey, so I rarely stayed after the meetings.
entries.zh: 俱乐部里小圈子气氛浓厚，所以我很少在开完会后继续逗留。

entries.en: His close-cropped hair made the old scar above his ear more noticeable.
entries.zh: 他剪得短短的头发让耳朵上方的旧伤疤更显眼了。

entries.en: The close-run contest was decided by a single point in the final round.
entries.zh: 这场难分高下的比赛在最后一轮以一分之差决出了胜负。

entries.en: The director remained closeted with her advisers while reporters waited outside.
entries.zh: 记者们在外面等候时，那位主管仍与顾问们私下会谈。

entries.meaningZh: 所知甚多的〔英式；非正式〕
entries.en: A clued-up volunteer guided us through the complicated registration process.
entries.zh: 一位很懂情况的志愿者带我们完成了复杂的登记流程。

entries.en: The novel explores a co-dependent relationship involving a drug addict and his partner.
entries.zh: 小说探讨了一名吸毒成瘾者与伴侣之间的共依存关系。

entries.en: She transferred to a co-educational school after studying at a girls' academy.
entries.zh: 她在一所女子学校读书后，转到了一所男女同校的学校。

entries.en: Rain glistened on the cobbled lane outside the bakery.
entries.zh: 雨水在面包店外那条鹅卵石小巷上泛着亮光。

entries.en: We opened a cobwebbed cupboard that had not been used for years.
entries.zh: 我们打开了一个多年未用、蛛网密布的橱柜。

entries.en: The receiver printed a coded message onto a narrow strip of paper.
entries.zh: 接收机把一条编码信息打印在一条窄纸带上。

entries.en: The story's cold-hearted guardian sells the children's toys without asking them.
entries.zh: 故事里那个冷心肠的监护人把孩子们的玩具卖掉了，连问都没问他们。

entries.en: They are comfortably off now, but they still repair rather than replace old furniture.
entries.zh: 他们现在生活相当宽裕，但仍会修理旧家具，而不是换掉。

entries.en: It was a common-or-garden notebook, despite the elaborate box it came in.
entries.zh: 尽管装在精美的盒子里，那只是一本普通的笔记本。

entries.en: The compacted soil beside the gate was difficult to dig even after rain.
entries.zh: 大门旁的土被压得很实，即使下过雨也很难挖。

entries.en: Among the compared samples, only one retained its original colour.
entries.zh: 在这些进行比较的样品中，只有一个保留了原来的颜色。

entries.en: The report presents competing explanations that cannot both be true.
entries.zh: 报告提出了相互抵触的解释，两者不可能同时为真。

entries.en: The archive needs computer-literate volunteers to organise its growing digital collection.
entries.zh: 档案馆需要能使用计算机的志愿者来整理不断增加的数字馆藏。

entries.en: The training helped the volunteers become computerate before the library reopened.
entries.zh: 培训帮助志愿者们在图书馆重新开放前学会了使用计算机。

entries.en: The programme includes a condensed history of the theatre on its final page.
entries.zh: 节目单的最后一页附有一份剧院简史。

entries.en: A confessed admirer of silent cinema, she booked every screening in the series.
entries.zh: 她自认是无声电影的爱好者，订下了这个系列每一场放映的票。

entries.en: The young inventor was consumed with curiosity about the sealed machine.
entries.zh: 年轻发明家对那台密封机器充满了好奇。

entries.en: The contoured back of the chair had alternating ridges and shallow hollows.
entries.zh: 椅背呈波状外形，凸起的脊与浅凹槽交替排列。

entries.en: A cool-headed passenger found the emergency number while the others argued.
entries.zh: 其他人争吵时，一位头脑冷静的乘客找到了紧急联系电话。

entries.meaningZh: 有关警匪故事的〔影视书籍等〕
entries.en: The director replaced the cops-and-robbers plot with a quiet family story.
entries.zh: 导演把警匪故事情节换成了一个平静的家庭故事。

entries.en: The corseted actor asked for a break before the next dance scene.
entries.zh: 那位穿着胸衣的演员请求在下一场舞蹈戏之前休息一下。

entries.en: Punishing every small mistake proved counter-productive; the apprentices stopped asking questions.
entries.zh: 对每个小错误都加以惩罚，结果适得其反；学徒们不再提问了。

entries.en: The archive stores counter-revolutionary posters beside the pamphlets that answered them.
entries.zh: 档案馆把反革命海报与回应它们的小册子放在一起存放。

entries.en: She smoothed the creased map against the wall to read the faded names.
entries.zh: 她把有折痕的地图贴着墙抚平，好读清那些褪色的名字。

entries.en: The report describes the company as credit-worthy despite its recent losses.
entries.zh: 报告称这家公司虽然近期亏损，信用声誉仍然良好。
